notes: Sable: lean boarding-crew families (standard rig). A long charcoal coat with narrow shoulders, a high collar and tails that flare behind, a bandolier of amber cartridges and the collar lining (the tinted outfit), a cutter fuel tank on the back with hoses over the shoulders, and long-striding dark legs. A lean dark-furred head with a cream muzzle and amber eyes. A cutter torch is strapped to the outside of each forearm (a steel tube, a nozzle at the hand end) with a small blue-white flame burning forward along the arm in every pose (hard pixels, no glow layer). Head variants: bare, hood (the coat's hood), helmet (a breacher's helm with a lamp). Outfit mask = the bandolier, the collar lining, the cuffs, the helm's chin strap. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 33x33 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee.
